verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for Semgrep, since it is a SaaS AppSec platform that stores scan findings, so the axis applies. The pack shows only adjacent controls: code is analyzed locally by default, and the --dry-run flag stops scans from being uploaded to the web app. Neither is a documented way to set retention periods or delete stored data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
